pages.title: Poultice and Tincture
pages.text: $(l)Plague Poultice$() (Bubonic): paper; garlic, sage, dried rue. Makes two.$(br2)$(l)Wormwood Tincture$() (Septicemic, heated): glass bottle; two dried wormwood, dried rosemary.

pages.title: Broth, Vinegar, Theriac
pages.text: $(l)Herbal Broth$() (Dysentery, heated): bowl; garlic, dried sage, dried rosemary.$(br2)$(l)Four Thieves Vinegar$() (Pneumonic): glass bottle; fermented spider eye, garlic, dried rosemary, dried sage. Makes two.$(br2)$(l)Theriac$() (any, heated): glass bottle; dried rue, dried wormwood, honey bottle, rat tail.
The wrong remedy is wasted and does nothing. Any remedy can be given to a sick villager or animal as well as taken yourself.
